"""Invoice PDF rendering (v2: WeasyPrint, enabled by the invoice-pdf-v2 flag)."""
from weasyprint import CSS, HTML
from weasyprint.text.fonts import FontConfiguration

from src import flags

_FONTS = FontConfiguration()
_STYLE = CSS(
    string="@font-face { font-family: Inter; src: url(assets/Inter.woff2); } body { font-family: Inter; }",
    font_config=_FONTS,
)


def render_pdf(html):
    if not flags.is_on("invoice-pdf-v2"):
        raise RuntimeError("the old wkhtmltopdf renderer was removed; enable invoice-pdf-v2")
    return HTML(string=html).write_pdf(stylesheets=[_STYLE], font_config=_FONTS)

content.text:
Invoice PDFs are rendered by `render_pdf()` in `src/billing/pdf.py` using **WeasyPrint**. The font is set in code, in the `_STYLE` stylesheet at `src/billing/pdf.py:8-11`:

```python
_STYLE = CSS(
    string="@font-face { font-family: Inter; src: url(assets/Inter.woff2); } body { font-family: Inter; }",
    font_config=_FONTS,
)
```

To change the font, edit that `@font-face` rule and the `body { font-family: ... }` declaration.

**This is probably why you're getting the wrong font.** The rule points to `assets/Inter.woff2`, but there is no `assets/` directory and no font files (`.woff2`, `.ttf`, etc.) anywhere in the repo. Also, neither `CSS(string=...)` nor `HTML(string=...)` is given a `base_url`, so WeasyPrint has nothing to resolve the relative URL against even if the file existed. When it can't load Inter, it quietly falls back to whatever default font the system has. To fix it:

1. Add the font file to the repo (e.g. `src/billing/assets/Inter.woff2`).
2. Point to it with an absolute path or `file://` URL, or pass `base_url=` to both `CSS(...)` and `HTML(...)`. For example, build the path from `Path(__file__).parent / "assets" / "Inter.woff2"`.
3. Make sure the font file ends up in the deployed image.

**Your project notes say otherwise, and they're out of date.** A stored project note says PDFs use wkhtmltopdf/pdfkit with system fonts, so font problems should be fixed in the Dockerfile. That only applied while the `invoice-pdf-v2` flag was off. `flags.toml` now has it set to `true`, and the old wkhtmltopdf renderer has been removed (`render_pdf` raises an error if the flag is off). I've flagged that note in EngramDB as outdated so it stops pointing people to the Dockerfile.
